the climber begins · target audience

A single place for every kind of builder.

An ML engineer has skills but no clear problem. A designer craves a real project. A hardware engineer searches for a cause. A founder has an idea but no tech co-builder. A researcher holds a plan but no execution path.

three deliberate steps

Match. Mingle. Ship.

The vine branches into three tendrils, guiding each step from discovery to momentum.

Match

1. Match

Find your people.

Build a profile with your domain expertise, skills, and style. Browse Build Calls and find complementary collaborators.

Sprint

2. Mingle

Respond with what you bring.

High-context notes instead of resume spam. Posters connect directly with builders ready to start immediately.

3. Ship

Ship in a sprint.

Enter a 2-4 week sprint workspace with shared goals, sample datasets, and structured execution momentum.
